name: Wilderness Slayer Cave (ice giants)
accessNote: The higher-level ice giant variant (combat level 67) spawns in the Wilderness Slayer Cave (around levels 18-22). Multicombat, cannonable, and burstable. The cave is a popular player-killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
